items.summary: Otis has been selected once again to provide advanced modernization and vertical transportation solutions for Tianjin 117 Tower, a nearly 600-meter supertall landmark. It is the tallest building currently under construction in China and when complete, it will be China's third-tallest building, and host China's highest occupied floor at more than 584 meters 1 . Otis will provide 251 elevators and escalators across the tower, helping raise China's urban skyline to new heights. Otis (NYSE: OTIS) is the world's leading elevator and escalator manufacturing, installation, service and modernization company. The project brings together Otis' global high-rise expertise and innovation strength in China. "Tianjin 117 Tower is an extraordinary project that reflects the future of high-rise mobility in China," said Sally Loh, President, Otis Greater China.
